title: OneDrive: guided rename and move flow for max path sync errors on Windows
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned January 2027 rollout and Microsoft's statement that no admin action is required. Microsoft documentation supports the path-length explanation, existing folder-name control and product licensing; targeted searches found no documented switch for the new dialogs.

claims.claim: The decoded cloud file path limit is 400 characters for OneDrive and SharePoint in Microsoft 365.
claims.quote: The entire decoded file path, including the file name, can't contain more than 400 characters for OneDrive, OneDrive for work or school and SharePoint in Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: Microsoft Support describes the 520-character sync path as a local path up to 400 characters plus a root folder up to 120 characters.
claims.quote: The total path is the combination of the local path (up to 400 characters) and the OneDrive root folder (up to 120 characters). Paths exceeding 520 characters show a sync error.

claims.claim: Group Policy Management Editor exposes the control at Computer Configuration > Policies > Administrative Templates > OneDrive > Set a custom name for the OneDrive folder.
claims.quote:
Under Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\OneDrive, navigate to **Computer Configuration > Policies**.

![Computer Configuration policies in the Group Policy Management Editor]

### Set a custom name for the OneDrive folder

claims.claim: The documented registry setting is [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\OneDrive\CustomSyncRootFolderName] "TenantID"="CustomFolderName".
claims.quote:
Enabling this policy sets the following registry key to the value shown in the following example:

`[HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\OneDrive\CustomSyncRootFolderName] "TenantID"="CustomFolderName"`

claims.where: controls[0]; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Shortening the local OneDrive folder name increases available path length for nested files and folders.
claims.quote: Shortening this name increases the available path length for nested folders and files.

claims.claim: The custom folder name policy changes the name used when creating the sync root for new users.
claims.quote: If you enable this setting and provide a custom folder name, OneDrive will use that name when creating the sync root folder for new users.

claims.claim: Existing syncing users must unlink and relink their account for the folder-name change to take effect.
claims.quote: Users who are already syncing will need to unlink and relink their account for the change to take effect.

claims.claim: The full OneDrive sync root folder path cannot exceed 120 characters.
claims.quote: The full OneDrive sync root folder path (for example, `C:\Users\{alias}\OneDrive - {organization name}`) cannot exceed 120 characters.

claims.claim: The custom folder name policy's documented management applicability is Group Policy rather than Intune.
claims.quote:
### Set a custom name for the OneDrive folder

*Applies to: Group Policy*
